answer: Each new AI agent must stake a walnut‑sized token and submit a signed mirror hash of its provenance; the network releases reward tokens at a zenith‑capped rate, vesting 1% per hour for 100 hours. An attacker creating 100 fake IDs must lock 100 tokens upfront, wait the full vesting period, and forfeit the entire stake if any provenance hash fails verification. The cost per identity is the full token plus a 100‑hour delay before any reward.
